title: Flight duty period
text: A flight duty period may not exceed 13 hours, reduced by 30 minutes for each sector beyond the second.

title: Night duty
text: A duty that touches 00:00-06:00 India time may not exceed 10 hours and may include at most two landings in that window.

title: Duty in 7 days
text: No more than 60 duty hours in any 7 consecutive calendar days.

title: Flying in 28 days
text: No more than 100 block hours in any 28 consecutive calendar days.

title: Rest between duties
text: Rest before a duty must be at least 12 hours and at least as long as the duty before it.

title: Weekly rest
text: Every 7 consecutive days must include two clear days in a row.

title: Type rating
text: Crew must be active and rated on the aircraft type, and fly only for their own airline.

title: Certificates
text: Licence, medical, recurrent training and safety equipment certificates must all be valid on each duty date.

title: Home base
text: Crew are called out from their home base; anyone based elsewhere must be positioned on a flight that day, at a cost.
